name: Carved Centaur Totems
summary: Gurda Wildmane believes carved totems could help win the favor of the Gelkis or Magram. She needs authentic ones gathered from centaur clans across Desolace.

sections.title: A Centaur Currency
sections.body: Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post has watched centaur clans meet away from their settlements to trade. She has seen them use carved totems as currency. Now she thinks a large bundle might sway the Gelkis or Magram, but the totems she has carved may not pass as genuine. So she asks you to bring her authentic examples.

faq.answer: Gurda Wildmane asks you to bring her authentic carved centaur totems.

faq.q: Why does she need carved totems?
faq.answer: Gurda believes a large bundle could help win the favor of the Gelkis or Magram.

faq.q: Where do centaur use the totems?
faq.answer: Gurda has seen centaur from different clans meet away from their settlements and trade with carved totems as currency.

faq.q: Where can I find Gurda Wildmane?
faq.answer: Gurda Wildmane is at Ghost Walker Post.
Gurda hopes a bundle of totems could win favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram.
